entities.summary: Emmanuel Bushayija is the claimant to the historical Kingdom of Rwanda, which was abolished in 1961. He was proclaimed the ceremonial successor to the royal title (Mwami) on 9 January 2017 under the reign name Yuhi VI by the Abiru, the privy council of the Rwandan monarchy. He succeeded his late uncle King Kigeli V and is a grandson of King Yuhi V. Yuhi VI was a performers & entertainers from Ruanda-Urundi (b. 1960-12-20, Ruanda-Urundi). Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
